book.name: Isáysa
book.title: Isáysarini kuku Nuw Isáysi yuwaa Apanll kamanirangu anoo kamanchintspa

content: Saanamun yutaritshish Apanll siyaa kizpur waneerangiya

content.text: ¿Antaati nuw siyaa Israelchicheetsis tputs kizaa kasataru, sheeruri kasarangee? Nda.
Tputs wizanllee natsaku, kapeetaru, ¿antaati nuw siyaa ashirangeezi?
Saantari nuwaa ngatarangus, nuwaa kuki nduntam mazinarangus,
¿Nitaati nuw siyaa tputsireem muchchuri tupaxanxarangee? Nda.
¿Antaati nuw tputseem tumashtakinawa, kurik putapi aturi, siyaa tupaxanxapi?
Nuw siyash kusaranguri, naparanguri, minamtiyam tputsee nda parangina.
Nuw siyaa kapung kuruzaranguri, minamtiyam nda ¡Maya! siy tárangsa.
Itaru, siy nuwaa, ¿Antaati Apanll iyaa istacheeja? tárangsa.
¿Nitaati Apanll kundarareetsini iyaa itutsimaam waritcheeja? tárangsa.
musá kapungu, Puzangi tákchuri, puzataraa ashtachiya.
Kung nduneekchu, mangu kayupich tsipayarusin, kuchachinllinaya
kanind kantseerpipitaraa, sheeru, sin sinakchu, tputs tsiparingaz tanuku sur xuwat xuwat ashtaru ashtachiya.

content: átcha Apanllee. Ashiriya, saanamandari yutaritshishiris Apanll siyaa waneekiya, nuw siyaa atina. Apanllee wipunash kizpuritaa kiyung yachakusin, uru Apanllimun mang' tatkiya Apanll wipunash átcha:

content.text: kis támkachuri, kukoo kamiran nuw mazinakina.
Nuw Apanllee kuk pakchiyam nda kapeetkina.
Itaru, nuw kamiran kushtarangina, kundarari nuwaa kushi pzkoomaama.
Kundararshiti nuwaa susi xputa xputa ashiranganaya.
¿Antaati nuw ksimunarangeezi? Nuwash kachi kawachta, kawachta ashiranganaya.
Nuwaa kizpuritaa yutarit tsiyatarangsin, nuwsha zamaruri mazinazinaw ashirangina.
Nuw patumbichpaz ashiruri, nda pakchiyam pazirangina.
Ayamtaa Apanll nuwaa tapachindakchu, ndunshaparee pazichina.
nuwsha, Natunaa, kurakap nuwaa, Naani, táyarus, nuwaa yutarit tsiyatangandama, táchima.
Wandaya tputs nuwaa yutarit tsiyatamaam taarinaariya,

content: Apanll wipunash tárangiya. Ashiriya, Apanllee wipunash kizpuritaa kiyung yachaksin, uru Apanllimun mang' tatkiya, nuw siyaa atina.

footnotes.text: Matiwa 26.67; Márkosa 14.65 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
